Use case: ui-mockup. Production Unity sprite extraction/redraw from reference.
Reference image is the approved apple-tree game's Cash Wallet mockup. Recreate ONLY the single outer ivory modal background card from that image, stripped of all its contents. An isolated front-facing rounded rectangle with aspect ratio width:height 0.78, warm creamy ivory softly lit center, modest honey-orange rounded rim, soft upper-left bevel highlight and a modest shaded lower edge. Smooth, gentle toy-like dimensionality matching this exact reference. Border is about 2.5% of card width; restrained wood texture, not thick gold, no metallic or double frame. Preserve the reference's generous corner radius and warm ivory interior shading. No title, apple, text, numbers, button, close icon, inset progress area, line, money or other UI. The only visible object is the empty outer card. It must nearly fill the image canvas with only 2% transparent margin outside silhouette. True transparent background, no floor or checkerboard. Full clean silhouette, symmetrical front-on view, no perspective distortion. Preserve exact cream/orange art of the approved reference.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Isolate/redraw ONLY the small round orange close button at the upper-right of the approved Cash Wallet reference image. Match it faithfully: round warm vermilion-orange soft inflated surface, thin amber rounded rim, gentle upper-left highlight, slightly darker lower edge, cream white chunky rounded X at center with a restrained brown outline. A single front-facing circular 3D casual mobile game close button. Absolutely no pink, no green, no panel or background. Tight square framing with 4% clear margin. True transparent alpha. No letters, only the X close symbol. Do not include other parts of the reference.
